other_conditions: Eligible institutions must be AICTE approved institutions or university departments imparting technical education.
Coordinator must be a full‑time regular faculty with adequate teaching and research experience and publications.
Maximum of two proposals per institute per year.
The institute should have organized at least one self‑financing programme in the last 12 months.
A processing fee of ₹1,500 per proposal must be paid through RTGS/NEF.
benefits_summary: Funding up to ₹3,00,000 is provided to the institution/university for the induction or refresher programme.
